weakness: Payment page scripts not inventoried, authorized, or integrity-checked; no change- and tamper-detection on the page
source: P07 (SI-07 objectives); P03 G-028, G-063; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Remove analytics and support widget scripts from the payment page; inventory remaining scripts with written justification; subresource integrity and a content security policy; tamper-detection service alerting the on-call engineer
milestones: 2026-09-30 unneeded scripts removed; 2026-10-15 integrity controls and tamper-detection live

weakness: One approval deploys to the CDE; no security review of payment page changes; console changes not detected; builds not signed
source: P07 (CM-03 objectives); P03 G-029; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Two approvals (one from platform engineering) for CDE deployments; security review for payment page changes; alerts on console changes outside the pipeline; signed build artifacts
milestones: 2026-09-15 two-approval rule live; 2026-09-30 console change alerts and signed builds

weakness: Alerts watched in business hours only; no egress intrusion detection or DNS tunneling detection
source: P07 (SI-04 objectives); P03 G-062; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: DNS query logging with tunneling detection and network intrusion detection on CDE egress; 24x7 managed detection and response service
milestones: 2026-10-31 egress and DNS detection live; 2026-11-30 managed detection service live; 2026-12-31 tuning complete
resources_required: $96K per year managed detection; $22K per year egress detection

weakness: Merchant portal users with refund and virtual terminal rights sign in with a password only; passwords never expire; no dynamic risk analysis
remediation_plan: Require MFA for refund, funding account, virtual terminal, and user administration roles; risk-based sign-in analysis for other users, approved in writing by the Qualified Individual; step-up MFA for funding account changes
milestones: 2026-09-30 merchant communication; 2026-10-31 MFA enforced for high-risk roles

weakness: Termination misses tokens and local accounts; no scheduled review of cloud IAM and service accounts; contractor end dates not tracked
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P03 G-031, G-034; P01 R-011
remediation_plan: Termination checklist covering tokens, API keys, and local accounts; contractor end dates in the identity provider; six-month access reviews; quarterly reconciliation to HR
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first review of cloud and service accounts complete

weakness: Service accounts with administrator-level roles; broad merchant support roles
remediation_plan: One role per workload; remove administrator roles from service accounts; split support roles by function
milestones: 2026-10-31 service accounts rescoped; 2026-11-30 support roles split

weakness: Inventory, scope document, and data flows do not reflect the cloud tenant; payment page scripts and bespoke components not inventoried; scope not confirmed since migration
remediation_plan: New PCI DSS scope document and data-flow diagrams; software component inventory; six-month scope confirmation calendar with organizational change review
milestones: 2026-09-30 scope confirmed and signed by the COO; 2027-03-31 next confirmation

weakness: No alerts when log sources, EDR agents, or WAF rules fail; 9-day log gap in May 2026
source: P07 (AU-05 objectives); P03 G-053; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Alerts for silent log sources, stopped agents, and security control changes; documented response procedure

weakness: Audit logs not reviewed on weekends or holidays; review level not adjusted after migration
source: P07 (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-050; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Interim on-call daily review including weekends; then 24x7 review by the managed detection service (POAM-003)
milestones: 2026-10-15 interim on-call review; 2026-11-30 managed service review

weakness: No penetration test of the cloud environment; segmentation not tested every six months or after migration
remediation_plan: External, internal, and segmentation penetration test of the cloud CDE; segmentation retest every six months
milestones: 2026-10-15 test complete; 2026-11-15 findings fixed and retested; 2027-04-15 next segmentation test

weakness: Key-management procedures written for the old hosting; no custodian acknowledgments since the move
remediation_plan: Rewrite key-management procedures and the cryptographic architecture description for the payment HSM service; custodian acknowledgments

weakness: Unencrypted PAN outside the CDE: 2.3 million PANs in a data warehouse table (purged 2026-08-07) and PAN in support tickets and email
remediation_plan: Fix the extract job with an automated PAN block; monthly PAN discovery on the warehouse; PAN masking in ticketing and email; purge historical tickets; review access logs for the exposure window
milestones: 2026-08-07 table purged; 2026-09-30 extract fix and warehouse discovery; 2026-10-31 ticket and email masking and purge
resources_required: Staff time; ticketing masking add-on $6K per year

weakness: Dependency scanning only on the API gateway; no remediation window for critical dependency findings
source: P07 (RA-05 objectives); P03 G-026; P01 R-026
remediation_plan: Dependency scanning on all repositories; software component inventory; 30-day window for critical findings
milestones: 2026-10-31 scanning on all repositories; 2026-12-31 remediation window in effect

weakness: External reporting duties not assigned; sponsor bank designated contacts not on file
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 notification matrix; request and record the sponsor bank's designated contacts; quarterly contact confirmation
milestones: 2026-08-31 matrix approved; 2026-09-30 sponsor bank contacts recorded

weakness: Incident response plan outdated: no cloud coverage, reportable incidents, metrics, or information sharing; not updated since 2023
source: P07 (IR-08 objectives); P03 G-078, G-096; P01 R-015
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; distribute to the response team; tabletop exercise on the P08 scenario; 24/7 on-call
milestones: 2026-08-31 POL-03 approved; 2026-09-30 runbook distributed; 2026-10-31 tabletop complete

weakness: Backup integrity not verified by restore tests; security documentation not backed up
remediation_plan: Quarterly settlement database restore test with reconciliation; versioned backup of security documentation

weakness: AOCs missing for 2 of 6 service providers; no responsibility matrices; no ongoing monitoring
source: P07 (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-075; P01 R-016, R-022
remediation_plan: Obtain AOCs or include providers in the ROC; responsibility matrix per provider; annual review of AOCs and SOC 2 reports (P09)
milestones: 2026-10-15 AOCs requested and received; 2026-10-31 matrices signed
